meta.title: Deleting a line item on an active event sets it deleted and voids associations
gaps: The available setup has exactly one active line item, so the deletion is refused rather than setting the line item to deleted.
No available operation or read-back field verifies association void/inactive status.
No available read-back field verifies PR quantity reconciliation.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event remains active.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot delete this line item from the project”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event remains active.
